items.text: Anna Moeller has represented the 43rd District in the Illinois House since 2014. She earned history and public administration degrees from Northern Illinois University, and previously served on the Elgin City Council and as executive director of the McHenry County Council of Governments. She chairs the Health and Human Services Appropriations Committee and leads the Medicaid Working Group.

sentences.text: Anna Moeller has represented the 43rd District in the Illinois House since 2014.

She earned history and public administration degrees from Northern Illinois University, and previously served on the Elgin City Council and as executive director of the McHenry County Council of Governments.
She chairs the Health and Human Services Appropriations Committee and leads the Medicaid Working Group.

items.text: She sponsored HB1910, a libraries-opioid antagonists measure enacted in 2025. She sponsored HB5408 to require exchange insurers to send 90% of unspent abortion funds to a state access fund. She supports protecting Illinois waterways, citing flood control and water quality. Her campaign says she supports reproductive freedom, senior services, and affordable healthcare, and opposes Medicaid and Social Security cuts.
